rule: every canvas the page draws is one monitor; the number is its order of appearance on the page, 1 first; the wall lays them out left to right, then the next row, and two monitors that sit side by side in their section stay side by side on the wall (the founder's orders of 20 and 21 October)

kill.label: Kill switch
kill.what: Omni-Compass ON (green) or engaged (red): every setting handed back to native at once; every Omni-Compass side follows native (white)
kill.where: the kill switch (section 1a; its wiring, section 1e)

dial.label: The dial
dial.what: the max (every muscle to its own limit) or the tune-down (never more than native)

load.label: Demand
load.what: ×0.25 to ×2 of the day's own demand, both arms alike

noise.label: Noise
noise.what: σ of the demand's noise, one draw a muscle a decision, both arms alike

lag.label: Sense delay
lag.what: decisions added between what a muscle does and what its controller reads, both arms alike

faults.label: Faults
faults.what: a surge, half the machines lost, a sense blind, a security hold, on the chosen body part

step.label: One decision
step.what: step the engine one decision while paused

frame.label: Frame load
frame.what: +0, +8 or +16 ms burned inside every frame of this page

run.label: Run
run.what: A, B or C (or the archived run) the monitor plays

rep.label: Repetition
rep.what: which repetition of the run is replayed

arm.label: Arm
arm.what: which arm stands on the right: Omni-Compass governing, or watching only

stack.label: Stack
stack.what: the GPU card, the Linux host, Kubernetes or the cloud

governor.label: Governor
governor.what: which orchestrator or governor is shown

scenario.label: Scenario
scenario.what: on-site bare metal, through the cloud, in the device, as a service

reading.label: Reading
reading.what: every measured piece carried, or the index's strict rule

chip.label: The chip's run
chip.what: the chip's one run beside the count or in it

gauge.label: Gauge
gauge.what: which gauge of the run is shown

filter.label: Filter
filter.what: which rows, words, families or organisms are shown

body.label: Body
body.what: which body the organism runs: the harness, the organism, every muscle alone

muscle.label: The muscle's own switch
muscle.what: pick one muscle on either ring: its card, and its own switch, which hands that one muscle back to native (Omni-Compass OFF on it) or puts Omni-Compass on it again; the kill switch hands every muscle back at once
muscle.where: the organism's monitors and the muscle's card (section 6a)

runs.label: Runs
runs.what: how many of the Python's runs this page computes again

print.label: Print
print.what: the receipts of the runs, printable, with the digests and the notice

seed.label: Seed base
seed.what: which held-out seed base's 500 scenarios are replayed
